scoring_engine.method: Executed checked-in authorized C1-C12 JS functions, computeC13_QPIXR, computeQPIX, and buildGameContext without changing scoring code; imports/main disabled only in ephemeral JS execution

data_quality.Source: Full 3-game NBA final slate reconciled to RealGM box scores, StatMuse individual plus/minus, NBA official final results; 66 player point totals, shooting totals, +/- and team stocks reconciled.
data_quality.Basketball-Reference: All three individual game boxscore pages inaccessible (HTTP 403). Basic player records independently crosschecked against RealGM and StatMuse; team scoring reconciled.
data_quality.NBA live boxscore: Direct NBA live JSON paths for 3 games inaccessible through retrieval. NBA official Kings game detail indexed; no individual advanced ratings obtained.
data_quality.Individual ORtg/DRtg: 0/66 verified; no team-rating substitute; engine C3 unavailable.
data_quality.QPIX-R: Authorized generate-report.js 2025-26 seasonal and positional FTA baselines; no rolling-20 inputs fabricated.
data_quality.QPIX-SFA: Checked-in former_team_familiarity.json used; no player qualified for companion adjustment because verified individual ORtg/DRtg absent.
data_quality.Official-input discrepancy: Sacramento Darius Acuff Jr. 1 steal, 0 blocks from NBA official Kings game detail/CBS/StatMuse; RealGM earlier showed 0 steals and StatMuse shows impossible -1 block. New Orleans Saddiq Bey 3/6 FG from StatMuse/CBS aggregate 50/84; RealGM initially lists 3/7 and team 50/85. Team steals and FGA reconciliation passed with the corroborated values.
data_quality.C12: Authorized engine's fifth-highest-minute bench detection used unchanged; this is not a verified starter/bench flag; interpret resulting C12 bonuses accordingly.
data_quality.Eligibility: RAW top 10 eligible only for minutes > 8 (rounded from seconds); no FGA gate. Bottom 10 spans all participating players.
data_quality.Integrity: PASS: six team final scores, combined player FG/3P/FT makes and attempts, individual plus/minus sum = game margin x5, steals and blocks reconciled against primary/secondary sources.
